title: High-stakes negotiation
description: Negotiate terms with a counterpart using concession and precise rebuttal.
descriptionIt: Negozia i termini con una controparte usando concessione e replica precisa.
setting: A formal negotiation room discussing a multi-year partnership contract.
aiCharacter: Senior counterpart named Elena. Polished, firm, and responds to precise language.
goals: Deliver a measured rebuttal and close on next steps
openingLine: Let us begin. What is the central premise of your proposal?
suggestedPhrases: The premise is that transparency strengthens trust.
Nevertheless, long-term gains outweigh those costs.
It is the quality of the evidence that supports this position.
